Assessment briefing

Work independently and show evidence across strings, functions, lists, debugging, implementation and testing.

Architecture Checkpoint

This assessment checks whether you can read, repair, modify and build structured Python programs.

  • Complete the knowledge and tracing questions.
  • Repair both supplied programs and test the corrections.
  • Complete all four practical tasks.
  • Use IDLE for the final structured program and submit the .py file.
  • Record clear review evidence before saving the workbook.
